nodes.name: Animated 60s op art: vertical stripes shifted into concentric diamonds, thinning from left to right

Op Art Vibrations is ready: banded stripes shifted into diamonds or circles, with stripe spacing, band height, thickness, taper and speed, plus presets for Classic yellow, Red circles, Cobalt square and Acid star.
PCB layouts and schematics: chips and parts wired by routed traces, on blueprint blue.
Isometric wireframe scenes: a central object on platforms, ringed by blocks and wide orbits.
A math function sampled on a coarse grid: aliased moiré staircases, animated.
An animated cross-stitch field. Your cursor sews colored stitches that slowly unravel.

limitations: Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
